project.description:
The article check, as a base class a group module can extend.
NOT A GROUP. It declares no collections and carries no text, so it is not grafted onto any root and RootLibraryTest never sees it. It exists because the check every group needs - does this text actually parse - is the same check, and a copy of it in each of six modules is six chances to fix a bug in five places.
Main sources rather than a test-jar, and JUnit at compile scope, so that consuming it is an ordinary test-scoped dependency. A test-jar would work and is the idiom this repository does not otherwise use; one new module is cheaper to understand than one new build trick.
